validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, independently confirmed. This is the FERC-jurisdictional 'MountainWest Pipeline System' (operating legal entity 'MountainWest Pipeline, LLC', formerly Questar Pipeline Company), williams.com's own labeled heading distinct from its other MountainWest sub-systems on the same page. CLASSIFICATION: correctly natural-gas transmission (Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission), an operating interstate mainline, not a gathering/lateral/storage-only asset. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate of either sibling row despite the shared 'MountainWest Gas Pipeline' sheet name. Distinguished by an independently labeled, independently sourced spec set: P6898 (this row) = 'MountainWest Pipeline System' heading on williams.com, 1,868 mi / 2.6 million dekatherms per day (2,600 MMcf/d) / 14 compressor stations, spanning Colorado-Wyoming-Utah. P6899 (Overthrust) = a separate heading on the same page, ~261 mi / 3 compressor stations, in Wyoming/Utah (own row, own agent). P7785 (Westbound Compression) = a discrete FERC-approved (Oct 2024) compression-ONLY expansion project on the Overthrust system (Wamsutter WY to Opal WY, +0.3 MMdth/d, LengthKnown=0 per gem.wiki's own record: 'Length: 0 mi'), placed into service during 2025 per Williams' FY2025 10-K -- confirmed via the gem.wiki page fetched for cross-checking only (never cited as a ref): 'Operator: MountainWest Overthrust Pipeline ... Start year: 2025'. No evidence of value duplication across the three rows (each carries its own distinct mileage/capacity figures traceable to a distinct heading/project). ATTRIBUTION note (not a validity defect, but flagged for the record): prompts/P6898.md's scope guidance states Williams acquired MountainWest 'in 2024' -- this is off by roughly a year. Two independent primary sources agree the closing was 2023-02-14: Williams' own FY2025 10-K ('On February 14, 2023, Williams closed on the acquisition of 100 percent of MountainWest Pipelines Holding Company') and seller Southwest Gas Holdings' 8-K/A pro forma exhibit ('On February 14, 2023, Southwest Gas Holdings, Inc. ... completed its previously announced sale of all of the equity interests in MountainWest Pipelines Holding Company ... to ... Williams Partners Operating LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Williams Companies, Inc.'). Staged Owner fill uses the correct 2023 date. SPEC: Location cannot be fully captured by the schema's 2-endpoint model -- Questar Pipeline Company's own 1993 10-K describes the mainline as two historical segments both running Colorado-to-Utah with Wyoming as a mid-route transit state ('the northern segment extends from northwestern Colorado through southwestern Wyoming into northern Utah; the southern segment ... extends from western Colorado to Payson, in central Utah'), corroborated independently by our own measurement of the route geojson's extent (lon -111.98 to -107.52, lat 39.08 to 42.01 -- Ogden UT to NW Colorado via Rock Springs WY). Staged Start=Colorado/End=Utah per the schema's 2-field limit, with Wyoming noted in the Location fill's researcher_notes as a real transit state the schema can't capture.
